description: This file defines the Ext.ux.grid.filter.ListFilter class, which extends Ext.ux.grid.filter.Filter to provide a list-based filtering component for Ext JS grids. It allows for configuring options either through a local array or a remote data store, and provides methods for getting/setting filter values, serialization, and validation within grid filtering functionalities.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.filter.ListFilter
classes.description: A filter class that provides a list-based filter for Ext JS grids, with configurable options and support for local and remote data sources.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, creating its menu component and setting up event handling.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the currently selected value(s) from the list menu.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the selected value(s) in the list menu and triggers an update event.

methods.name: isActivatable
methods.description: Determines if the filter can be activated based on its current configuration.

methods.name: getSerialArgs
methods.description: Serializes the filter's current settings into an object suitable for transmission to the server.

methods.name: onCheckChange
methods.description: Handles the 'checkchange' event on the menu, triggering a delayed update.

methods.name: validateRecord
methods.description: Validates a data record against the current filter criteria.
